prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a parking lot collision. The patient had 6 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1142; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with reported head impact and subsequent headache, dizziness, and difficulty concentrating. Over six visits, care consisted of symptom monitoring, cognitive and vestibular assessment, graded activity guidance, and education on concussion precautions. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the symptoms described and with the force of the collision as documented. Neurological examination showed some findings supportive of concussion, including mild balance deficits and reduced performance on attention tasks, while other testing, including cranial nerve examination, coordination, and strength, was within normal limits. No prior injury to the head or neck has been identified in the available history. Treatment followed a typical course, with frequency of visits decreasing as symptoms improved and the patient returned toward baseline function. Billing records reflect one charge per scheduled service with no duplicate entries. Prognosis is good with continued gradual return to normal activities.
